title: Contact

intro.heading: Tell me what you’re working on.
intro.description: Whether you’re planning an event, looking for communication coaching, or exploring a workshop, send the details below and I’ll get back to you with the next step.

privacyText: Your information will only be used to respond to your inquiry and discuss potential collaboration.
successMessage: Thank you — your inquiry has been received. Please watch your email inbox for a personal response from Hamza.
failureMessage: Your message could not be sent. Please check your connection and try again, or email directly at hamzakhan21@ku.edu.tr.

faqs.question: Do you work with clients internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes. Coaching is available online internationally, while speaking engagements and workshops can be delivered virtually or in person depending on the opportunity.

faqs.question: Is coaching online?
faqs.answer: Yes. Individual coaching, founder pitch coaching, and the group intensive can be delivered online.

faqs.question: What is the difference between speaking, workshops and coaching?
faqs.answer: Speaking is designed for larger audiences and idea-led events. Workshops are interactive group sessions with practice and feedback. Coaching is more personalized and focused on an individual or small-group communication goal.

faqs.question: Do you offer group coaching?
faqs.answer: Yes. Present With Confidence is the current small-group coaching pathway, built around clear thinking, confident delivery, and communicating under pressure.

faqs.question: How does the 4-week intensive work?
faqs.answer: It is a structured small-group communication intensive with guided practice and feedback. Current cohort dates, format, availability and quotation are shared after inquiry.

faqs.question: How are quotations handled?
faqs.answer: Pricing is not listed publicly. After an inquiry, Hamza confirms fit, format and scope and provides a private quotation.

faqs.question: Who is founder pitch coaching for?
faqs.answer: Founders preparing an investor pitch, startup competition, demo, important presentation, or high-stakes Q&A.

faqs.question: Can an organization request a custom workshop?
faqs.answer: Yes. Workshops can be adapted to the audience, communication challenge, available time and delivery format.

faqs.question: How do I inquire or book?
faqs.answer: Choose the relevant inquiry type on this page, share the essential details, and Hamza will follow up with the appropriate next step.
